### The stability complaints

The single most common theme, across every platform, is that Rork crashes and breaks. Another: "when prompted it showed no progress, asked me to come back then showed an app running but crashes when trying to view it. cant see any code, or anything just nothing." A third, titled "Looks great but crashes after trying to open first project": "the project says 'Running' but each time I click it, Rork crashes after a few seconds." results.title: Rork AI Reviewed by an AI Product Designer (2026)
results.content:
Rork AI pricing plans follow a typical freemium model. You can start building for free - no credit card required - and then upgrade to paid tiers as your project scales in size and complexity.

However, in my personal experience, the Rork Free plan was simply not working. I could see 5 credits/mo in Free tier, but I never got it on signing up; instead, was pushed to Rork Max on my attempt to upgrade. That was a little frustrating. Moreover, I corroborate several online customer reviews of Rork in 2026, that theirs is a credit-guzzling no-code app builder.

In other words, the Rork AI is free to try, but not really free to build seriously.

Fix the frustrating issue of subscription status not reflecting after purchase in Rork apps. Few things are more frustrating for both developers and users than completing a purchase only to find the app still showing the free tier. This is one of the most common support requests for subscription-based Rork apps, and it usually comes down to one of a handful of specific implementation issues.
